steps.content:
March 16, N.F. 113, 23:30
Romanesque Hall

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Do you have something to say to me?

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Shouldn't you have something to say to me?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Haha, right. Thank you, you came in time. If you were a minute late, ${PlayerName} would probably have been gone.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I'll be deeply sorry.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Hmph... But you look very excited.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Do you have new visitors now? There should be many newcomers these days.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Just let me know if you need help. I do... miss this place.
She jumps off the platform, brushes off the dust on herself, and leaves.
Oak Casket smiles and looks ahead. A blurry figure emerges.

steps.speaker: Emaciated Woman
steps.content: Miss... You were right... Death has liberated me. My pain can finally end...

steps.speaker: Emaciated Woman
steps.content: Now, can you take me to see Mia...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If there are no souls after death, if only fragments remain, then who are you consoling by granting these dying wishes?
...Is it for the comfort of the living?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Of course, she's waiting for you too...

steps.speaker: [Scene Change]
steps.content: (Scene change)
Nirvana Headquarters, Eastside
The woman stands by the window and looks toward the west coast, where the huge Black Ring glimmers. At the other end of the long desk, in the shadow, a man in a suit sits quietly.

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: I heard that new underling you snatched from the FAC made quite a scene in the West District, then deserted and went MIA. Nirvana has some major investments in the West District. We suffered severe losses this time.

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: Are you here to explain this incident to me, Miss Special Agent?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Haha, I've been busy meeting the underground scumbags. Your new investments in the West District... We'll get to that later.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: However, that new underling of mine did bring me some shocking intel.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: That Black Ring you claimed to have destroyed eight years ago, its owner is still alive and well. That's why I've come to take over that old file.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Hand over the data you've been keeping. The Inner Bay, the mines, Hypercubes, the workers' protests...

steps.speaker: Man In Suit
steps.content: Hmph... You want to get involved in Hypercubes too... Hyenas from the 9th Agency, have you got permission from Paradeisos?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: This bullet needs no permission from anyone. Hand it over. I need the complete file of <color=#fb9259>BR-002</color>.
